title: Cylindrical object (2 parts)
spec:
In the first part, construct a rectangular bar by starting with a new coordinate system using Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face, creating the first loop with four lines. Start with a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw a line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0547), followed by a line from (0.75, 0.0547) to (0.0, 0.0547), and finally a line from (0.0, 0.0547) back to the origin. Scale this sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0234 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting rectangular bar has a length of 0.7500000000000001 units, a width of 0.05468750000000001 units, and a height of 0.023437500000000003 units.

In the second part, construct a cylindrical object with a rectangular section. Begin by setting up a new coordinate system with Euler angles and a translation vector both set to zero. Draw the second two-dimensional sketch on the first face, creating the first loop with four lines. Start with a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw a line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0547), followed by a line from (0.75, 0.0547) to (0.0, 0.0547), and finally a line from (0.0, 0.0547) back to the origin. Scale this sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0234 units along the normal direction and add this extrusion to the existing solid body. The resulting cylindrical object has a length of 0.7500000000000001 units, a width of 0.05468750000000001 units, and a height of 0.023437500000000003 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the first part (rectangular bar)
rect_bar = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0547).lineTo(0, 0.0547).close().extrude(0.0234)

# Create the second part (cylindrical section)
cylinder = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0547).lineTo(0, 0.0547).close().extrude(0.0234)

# Combine the two parts
r = rect_bar.union(cylinder)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0547, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0547, 0.0234) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0234) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) and the translation vector is (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)
